title: Kamishiro Rui — Sentimental Snapshot〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These drones... No, I'll have to leave them behind. And my maintenance toolkit...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I won't need that either since it's not like Robo-Nene will be going with us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's good that I've started packing for the school trip, but I can't quite seem to decide what to take...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe I should look over that list again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Let's see... My phone's a must, of course.
The guidebook with our schedule, cash, my student ID...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A few changes of clothes, toiletries, writing utensils and some basic medicines just in case...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Along similar lines, some wrenches, a screwdriver, wire cutters, solder, circuit boards and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I haven't finished reading these books... They're not on the list, but it may be nice to have some books to read while on the bullet train.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My ideas notebooks too, just in case I see or think of something interesting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
My bag won't close...
No, what if I pressed harder?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, we're here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hello, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Thanks for having us☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You left your door open.
What are you...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, your floor's completely covered in all these different things.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I've never seen some of these parts before.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Were you doing something, or have these always been here...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, I know♪
You asked us all to gather to help you clean☆ Right?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Not quite...
I was packing for our school trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were packing? That doesn't exactly explain why we can't see the floor. Keeping things tidy has never been your strong point, has it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
There's no room for us in here.
How are we gonna watch the video of the 30th Anniversary Show...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Sorry, I'll clean this up now.
Let me move these out of the way first so you can all enter...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, wait, stop! Don't move a muscle!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There, now we can enter!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Ah, much better. Nice work.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But there's this pile still left.
You said you were packing for the school trip, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Those are all things I was thinking about taking with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is actually much less compared to what I originally had. When we went over to the United States, I took quite a few things that I didn't end up using.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But this pile's huge... I mean, do you really need to bring all these tools along? It's not like you're gonna be doing maintenance on Robo-Nene while you're over there.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know, but I was thinking, “What if I need them just in case?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Just in case?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, for example, if the bullet train were to break down...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even if that were to happen, the rail company's repair crew should be handling that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, what if the emergency sprinklers where we're staying malfunction and—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The teachers and staff will do something about that. Why are you under the impression that you have to fix everything yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because it would cause everyone a lot of trouble if I didn't.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, Rui's our knight in shining armor.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, that's so nice of you☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that is kind of him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you won't have room for souvenirs and such if your bag is this full from the start.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What?! You've gotta make room for memories!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, Rui, you should try to have as much fun as you can on this trip...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much...
I agree...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: H-Haha. Sorry, I know this is all happening really suddenly... It's also probably pretty obvious that I'm not exactly the outgoing type, so... I-If you don't want to join us, we'll understand!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: But it would be nice to have you in our group, Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes, this trip may finally give me a chance to...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As worried as I am about certain unfortunate occurrences, it's probably best for me to leave some of these behind...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If possible, would you all mind advising me on what I should or should not take...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! First, we're taking out all of these tools!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?! All of them? But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're not gonna use this soldering iron or these circuit boards. Emu, can you put these on that shelf for me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, but...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Now take out all these notebooks...
Um... You have one for directing and one for story writing?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You have so many different notebooks, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I understand your reasoning, but you could bring just one for this trip. You could also cut and paste your notes into the right book when you get home. How does that sound?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, KAITO, you're right...
One would make things quite a bit easier.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, these too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Books...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
...!
I was going to read those on the bullet train.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You were? Then, that seems fine.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
I was worried that you were also going to toss those out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You give us far too little credit.
All we're trying to do is whittle this down to the bare essentials for your trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! Your bag feels so much lighter now☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't believe it...
Just this for three days and two nights?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I really think I should take some tools—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Nope!
You'll just have to do with the ones you keep hidden in your pockets.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree!
So, put that wrench down!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I hope you have lots and lots of fun on this trip, Rui☆>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We'll be looking forward to seeing what you bring back♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Now now...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you all very much...
I promise to have as much fun as I can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it's getting late, so why don't we start watching the video of the anniversary show?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Woohoo!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all for helping me with this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It was our pleasure.
Now, let's get that projector we set aside back out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
